title: Stop Improving the Marketing. Fix the Product.
description: More traffic cannot rescue a weak product. Use validation, simplification, competition, operational cost, and inventory risk to diagnose what needs fixing before buying more attention.
cta: Next, we separate attention from conversion and find the exact point where sales are being lost.
alternativeTitles: Before You Spend More on Marketing, Test the Product
More Traffic Can Make a Bad Product Problem Worse

shortA.title: Maybe You Do Not Have a Marketing Problem
shortA.alternateHook: More traffic cannot rescue a product that does not survive real customer interest.

shortB.title: Too Many Choices Can Hurt Sales
shortB.alternateHook: More options can create more confusion, inventory, errors, and slower decisions.
